guhwinter.verhaal.bal: You hang a shiny pink bauble in the tree. It fits right next to Suus' ring box.
guhwinter.verhaal.bezig: You're still busy with something else, chonky.
guhwinter.verhaal.doel.sparren: the little spruces in the valley
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.boek: The Big Book lies next to the Sint's chair. Sign up for the Secret Sint draw (if you like)!
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.pakjes: Ozovads is back! Now find %s glittering presents that went overboard. They only glitter for you.
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.pakjesavond: It's pakjesavond! Everyone is at Krijn and Corine's. Hurry to the Winterplein!
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.schoen: You've got a carrot for Ozovads. Put your shoe by the chimney in Krijn and Corine's house!
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.sparren: Off to the little spruces outside the square, by the rocks in the valley!
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.spoor: Follow the carrot trail by the portal: Ozovads can't be far!
guhwinter.verhaal.hint.terug: All presents found! Bring them back to the Pakjesboot at the quay.
guhwinter.verhaal.kaartje.hangt: Your card is on the notice board! Everyone can read it. Wahoog!
guhwinter.verhaal.kaartje.leeg: An empty card? That's a very easy one to keep. Write something on it!
guhwinter.verhaal.kaartje.niet: You can't pin up a card right now. First hear what the six are planning (New Year's Eve)!
guhwinter.verhaal.kaartje.uitleg: What are you going to do this year? It goes on a card on the notice board, for everyone to read.
guhwinter.verhaal.klaar.kerst: Chapter 2 done! From Papa Krijn and Mama Corine: a %s and %s pepernoten. Merry Christmas!
guhwinter.verhaal.klaar.oudjaar: Chapter 3 done! Your very own %s and %s pepernoten. Happy New Year, wahoog!
guhwinter.verhaal.klaar.sint: Chapter 1 done! For the Sint's helper: a %s and %s pepernoten. Wahoog!
guhwinter.verhaal.open.kerst: Chapter 2 of the winter story is open: Christmas at Mum & Dad's! Joost and Niels still need a Christmas tree.
guhwinter.verhaal.open.oudjaar: Chapter 3 of the winter story is open: New Year's Eve! Lin has something to say about oliebollen.
guhwinter.verhaal.open.sint: A steamboat has arrived at the Winterplein... The winter story begins! (Chapter 1: The Lost Sint)
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.boom.0: Outside the square, between the rocks, a few little spruces stand in the snow.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.boom.1: There they are! Which one do you like best, chonky?
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.boom.2: I've already measured them. None of them fits in the train. Just saying.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.boom.4: The three of you haul the tree to Krijn and Corine's house. It's standing in the living room now. Time to decorate!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.boom.groot.0: Ambitious. You'd need a freight train at least. Respect.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.boom.klein.0: Good choice. It just doesn't fit in the train, but almost.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.kort.0: Hey, you missed pakjesavond! It was so cosy. Someone banged on the door and there was a whole sack full of presents.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.kort.1: And I had a poem for Joost. From the Sint. Definitely not from me. Want to hear it?
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.kort.2: 'Not a boxing ring, not a key ring, not an onion ring, but one with a little stone. You know: that thing.'
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.kort.3: Lovely, right? It all rhymed on 'ring'. I still don't get why. Maybe that's a Sint thing?
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.0: Oliebollen baking! The whole house will smell of frying fat. Lovely.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.1: I'm not deep-frying anything. Never again. Not after... the churro incident.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.2: She still won't talk about it. There was a funfair. There were churros. That's all I'm allowed to say.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.3: There was fat. Fat everywhere. I still see churros when I close my eyes.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.4: So I'm doing mine in the airfryer. Healthy, safe, no splatters.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.5: Oliebollen from an airfryer? Aren't those just... warm bread rolls?
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.6: An airfryer isn't a real fryer. Just like a hot-air balloon isn't real public transport.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.airfryer: I'll bake with Lin in the airfryer
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.nog: Not in the mood after all? No problem. The batter will wait for you.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.lin.pan: I'll bake them in the pan, like grandma Marrie
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.0: Dear chonkies, grandpa's here! This is grandpa Jochum!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.2: Yes, yes. Would you like some coffee, grandpa Jochum?
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.3: Corine, dear. His name is Wijnand. He's my father.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.4: I've called him Jochum for forty years. We're not changing that now, dear.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.5: I've been called Wijnand for eighty years. We're not changing that either.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.6: Come on, grandpa Jochum, have a nice seat by the fire.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.7: ...Wijnand. (He sits down anyway. It's a very nice chair.)
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.jochum.1: ...Wijnand. But fine. You're sweet, so you get two Christmas cookies anyway.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.opa.wijnand.1: Finally. Someone with some sense. You get an extra Christmas cookie. Two, even.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.0: Okay, now Lin's. From the airfryer. I'm not expecting much. Wait... WAIT.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.1: How is that possible?! Lin's are the tastiest! Fluffy, crispy, and not a drop of fat!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.2: No fat. No splatters. No churros. Only love.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.3: My sweet Lin is a genius. I've been saying it for years.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.4: I have to admit: the airfryer IS a real fryer. The hot-air balloon is still not real public transport.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.airfryer: Your oliebollen from the airfryer are done. Score: %s!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.goed: Round, brown, tasty. Just right! Grandma Marrie would be proud.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.pan: Your oliebollen from the pan are done. Score: %s!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.raar: They're... unique. Not a single one is the same. One of them looks like a tram.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.top: These are the most beautiful oliebollen I have ever seen. I'm going to cry a little. From happiness. And from the powdered sugar in my eye.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.proef.vulkaan: Is this an oliebol or a volcano? ...I'm eating it anyway. Nyeg.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.0: Doesn't it look lovely, darlings! Now to decorate it.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.1: Look Joost, I'm hanging up a bauble. It's a bit... square. With velvet. And it opens. Something small would fit in it perfectly.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.2: Haha, a square bauble! You could keep a pepernoot in there.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.3: ...A pepernoot. Yes. Exactly what I was thinking.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.4: Will you hang your drawing in it too? After Christmas everyone gets all the drawings in the Christmas Album!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.bal: I'll just hang up a bauble
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.versieren.tekeni: I'll make a drawing for the tree
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.0: Almost New Year! Time for resolutions. Who's first?
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.evi: And we're going to Japan again!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.evi2: By plane, Niels. ...Okay, by train to the airport.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.joost: This year I'm finally going to learn to juggle! With oliebollen!
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.joost2: A knee? No, you juggle with your hands, Suus. With oliebollen.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.kaartj: And you? Write your resolution on a card and pin it on the notice board! Then everyone can read it.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.liek: I'm going to give someone a compliment every day. Lin, your hair looks nice today.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.lin: No more fried things. No chips either. ...Except maybe on Saturdays. From the airfryer.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.lin2: Thanks, love. You said that yesterday too.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.niels: More public transport. A new train line every week. And a night-bus pass. Just because I can.
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.suus: Me. This year I'm getting... clarity. (She looks at Joost for a very long time.)
guhwinter.verhaal.praat.voornemen.suus2: Joost... your resolution. Does it happen to involve a knee? And a question?
guhwinter.verhaal.prikbord.leeg: No cards yet! The whole board is still empty. Just like Joost's diary.
guhwinter.verhaal.schoen.gezet: You put your shoe by the chimney, with a carrot in it for Ozovads. Now sleep on it...
guhwinter.verhaal.schoen.nacht: (Come back tomorrow: after a night the Sint may have put something in it.)
guhwinter.verhaal.schoen.suiker: You put your shoe by the chimney. No carrot? A sugar cube for Ozovads, then. Now sleep on it...
guhwinter.verhaal.schoen.vol: Your shoe has been filled! The carrot is gone, and there's a %s and %s pepernoten in it. Thank you, Sint!
guhwinter.verhaal.schoen.vol_terug: The Sint has already gone back to Spain, but there was still something in the chimney for you: a %s and %s pepernoten!
guhwinter.verhaal.schoen.wacht: Your shoe is still there. So is the carrot. A little more patience, chonky!
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.alpine.0: An ALPINE chick? There isn't even a mount... oh. There's a mountain.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.alpine.1: I'm never sleeping again. This was everything.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.alpine.2: Even in Japan they didn't have this!
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.alpine.3: Anthony, can I have those photos? For the fridge. All four hundred.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.begin: The Christmas walk begins! Walk along with the six around the pond.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.einde.0: What a walk! Come on, let's warm up with hot chocomel.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.einde.1: Saw two special birds today. Still no ring. But two birds.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.foto.0: WAIT. Is that a CHICKEN? In the WATER?? *click click click click*
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.foto.1: I have four hundred photos now. They are ALL blurry. Best day of my life.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.gestopt: The Christmas walk stopped: everyone wandered off. Click one of the six to start again.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.hint.0: Joost, if you ever want to ask something important... a walk is a really good moment.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.hint.1: Oh yes! Suus... what time is it, actually?
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.klaar: What a walk! Grandpa is coming soon, drop by Mama Corine in the house.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.koud: My nose is an ice lolly.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.niemand: The guhs aren't here right now. Try again in a bit.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.start.0: Christmas walk! Coats on, scarves on, wahoog!
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.start.1: Cosy, walking together. You know what else is cosy, Joost? Promising... things. Together. Forever.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.start.2: Yes! I promise I'll keep up this time!
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.vijver: Did you know no train runs here? Shame. A sprinter would fit here just fine.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.water.0: Look at those long toes! Just like a ballerina!
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.water.1: My heart. My heart can't handle this.
guhwinter.verhaal.wandel.water.2: I've wanted to see this for so long. Longer than I waited for the metro line.

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhwinter_sint.uitleg: Sinterklaas took the wrong turn at Slot Loevestijn and moored in the Guhmension. His horse is gone, his presents went overboard... Help the Sint, and celebrate Sinterklaas on the Winterplein!

scene.guhs.guhwinter_boomhalen.ballon: Hot-air balloon? ...No, never mind. A hot-air balloon isn't real public transport.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_boomhalen.boom: Nyeg! We still don't have a Christmas tree! Mama Corine is counting on the three of us.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_boomhalen.fiets: Then we buy the tree a bicycle day ticket.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_boomhalen.meter: Niels. It's a tree. Two metres tall.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_boomhalen.plan: I've already got a route. The 14:07 to Guhmension Valley, change to the sprinter, last bit by local bus.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_boomhalen.plek: There are lovely little spruces outside the square, by the rocks in the valley. Come on!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.bishop: Why is the bishop on a boat?? Is this normal?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.boot: From SPAIN? By BOAT? With a HORSE?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.geentrein: Niels, there's no train to Spain.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.goringuhm: Two years ago I arrived in Goringuhm right on time. Same boat, same map! Well. Almost the same map.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.helpen: You'll help the Sint, won't you, chonky? Follow the carrot trail by the portal. Ozovads can't have gone far with all those carrots.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.intro: The Winterplein, deep in the Guhmension. A pink steamboat chugs out of the mist into the harbour. A little too fast.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.kaart: The Guhmension? But I had the map right, didn't I? Left at Slot Loevestijn... or was it right?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.ozovads: Ozovads! No, don't! OZOVADS! ...He's gone. Towards the portal.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.pakjes: My Ozovads! And... where are the presents? Oh no, they went overboard with that bump!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.spanje: Honey, that's Sinterklaas. He comes from Spain by steamboat every year.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht.trein: Should've just taken the train. A steamboat isn't real public transport.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.bisho: Why is the bishop on a boat?? Is this normal?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.boot: From SPAIN? By BOAT? With a HORSE?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.geent: Niels, there's no train to Spain.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.gorin: Two years ago I arrived in Goringuhm right on time. Same boat, same map! Well. Almost the same map.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.helpe: You'll help the Sint, won't you, chonky? Follow the carrot trail by the portal. Ozovads can't have gone far with all those carrots.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.intro: The Winterplein, deep in the Guhmension. A pink steamboat chugs out of the mist into the harbour. A little too fast.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.kaart: The Guhmension? But I had the map right, didn't I? Left at Slot Loevestijn... or was it right?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.ozova: Ozovads! No, don't! OZOVADS! ...He's gone. Towards the portal.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.pakje: My Ozovads! And... where are the presents? Oh no, they went overboard with that bump!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.spanj: Honey, that's Sinterklaas. He comes from Spain by steamboat every year.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.terug: A few weeks ago, on this very square... (a memory)
scene.guhs.guhwinter_intocht_terug.trein: Should've just taken the train. A steamboat isn't real public transport.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.chef: Wait. I made a tiny burger. A TINY BURGER. I am a chef now.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.deur: The doorbell rings. Daan, Kim, Finn and Liv pop in for a moment!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.even: We're only staying a moment, the little ones have to go to bed soon.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.finn: Oh... for you that's fine, Finn.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.gefrituu: Nothing's being deep-fried, right? ...Okay. Then I'm in.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.gezellig: Yes. That's what makes it cosy.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.gourmet: To the table, dear chonkies! The gourmet set is on!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.kaas: I took a little pan! With cheese! And more cheese!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.nogeen: Would you like another gourmet pan?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.optijd: My little pan is always done right on time. Just like the train. Usually.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.pannetje: Honey, just grab a little pan. You can have a skewer too.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.toetje: Joost... you know what I've never had with dessert? Something small. Shiny. In a champagne glass.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_kerstdiner.zelf: So... you cook your own dinner. At the table. With tiny pans. On Christmas.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_ozovads.hinnik: Neigh! (That means: sorry, chonky. That boat was rocking so much. And I saw a carrot.)
scene.guhs.guhwinter_ozovads.psst: Psst... Ozovads? I've got a carrot for you.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_ozovads.samen: Ozovads munches the carrot and trots back to the square with you, good as gold.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_ozovads.spoor: The carrot trail ends at a few rocks and two little spruces. A pink blanket is sticking out!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.avond: Pakjesavond. Everyone is sitting cosily at Krijn and Corine's. Then...
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.deur: There he is! Krijn, quick, go and look at the door!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.gedicht: Joost, I have a poem for you. From the Sint. Definitely not from me.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.rijm1: 'The Sint saw Joost on the square, that darling, and thought: what is that boy still missing? Some kind of... ring.'
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.rijm2: 'Not a boxing ring, not a key ring, not an onion ring, but one with a little stone. You know: that thing.'
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.rijm3: 'Go down on one knee, it's really a simple thing, and then ask it quickly, with a shiny... ring.'
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.rijm4: 'Love from the Sint. And definitely not from Suus. (Ring.)'
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.santa: So Sinterklaas is like Santa, but with a horse, a boat, and poems about rings?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.snap: Wow, that rhymes so nicely! But why does everything rhyme on 'ring'? Is that a Sint thing?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.suus: Only with Suus, Anthony. Only with Suus.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.uienrin: I really fancy some onion rings now, by the way. Anyone else?
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.uitpakk: There's unwrapping, laughing and munching on pepernoten. Then Suus stands up, holding a sheet of paper.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_pakjesavond.zak: A whole sack of presents! And a note: 'Love from the Sint. PS: Ozovads says neigh.'
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.blijf: Then just stay here, Sint! We've got snow, chocomel and a whole square!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.boek: Write your name in the Big Book, next to my chair. On 2 December I'll draw the names!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.donut: A doughnut! Suus wants a doughnut, Sint! With icing!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.held: Ozovads! And the presents! Goodness me, what a hero you are, chonky.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.hier: Then this year we'll celebrate it here! WAHOOG!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.kaart: But my map is soaked, the boat is tired and I really don't know where Spain is any more.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.lijstje: Sint, can I put something on my wish list too? Something small. Round. Shiny. For my finger.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.schoen: And whoever puts their shoe by Krijn and Corine's chimney... who knows what they'll find? Here, a carrot for Ozovads.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.suus: Ho ho... that's not up to me, dear Suus. (The Sint looks very pointedly at Joost.)
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft.tel: Let me count them... one, two, five, wahoog... they're all here!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.bl: Then just stay here, Sint! We've got snow, chocomel and a whole square!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.bo: Write your name in the Big Book, next to my chair. On 2 December I'll draw the names!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.do: A doughnut! Suus wants a doughnut, Sint! With icing!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.he: Ozovads! And the presents! Goodness me, what a hero you are, chonky.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.hi: Then this year we'll celebrate it here! WAHOOG!
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.ka: But my map is soaked, the boat is tired and I really don't know where Spain is any more.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.li: Sint, can I put something on my wish list too? Something small. Round. Shiny. For my finger.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.sc: And whoever puts their shoe by Krijn and Corine's chimney... who knows what they'll find? Here, a carrot for Ozovads.
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.su: Ho ho... that's not up to me, dear Suus. (The Sint looks very pointedly at Joost.)
scene.guhs.guhwinter_sintblijft_terug.te: Let me count them... one, two, five, wahoog... they're all here!
A few weeks ago, on this very square... (a memory)
